knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The combination is a stop-work condition until authority and segregation are documented.
Each hazard has a different failure mode and needs its own control.
Cleaners identify and report; authorised people control the hazard.

practicalCriteria: Marks vehicle approach zones and dock-edge restrictions on a mock site plan.
Identifies the decision gate in the wet-clean case study.
Writes a traceable referral that separates observed conditions from assumed ones.
passRule: Zones and restrictions marked, decision gate identified, and referral traceable. Observed in the desk-based exercise. Not a site authorisation.
stopWorkCriteria: Active dock crossed or cleaned without segregation
Plant or trailer moved by the cleaner
